authority_rule: The original published study is the only source of truth. Every claim scored must trace to one of this study's primary_sources, with a page, table or figure reference. If a finding in this registry is not supported by the source, mark it not_testable with reason claim_not_in_any_source and say so; the registry can be wrong, the study cannot.

primary_sources.role: defines the deer mouse isoform site sets

replication_targets.finding: Deer mouse alpha-globin isoforms are defined by five sites: 50, 57, 60, 64, 71 (alphaI=PGAGS, alphaII=HGAGS, alphaIII=HAGDG); beta-globin by four sites: 62, 72, 128, 135 (betaI=GGAA, betaII=ASSS).
replication_targets.test: Do epistaeon's detected epistatic sites for HBA/HBB recover these positions above chance?

replication_targets.finding: Beta-chain isoform differences in O2 affinity are attributable to DPG sensitivity, not intrinsic affinity.
replication_targets.test: Does epistaeon assign the beta sites to a coupled group distinct from the alpha sites?

replication_targets.finding: High-altitude deer mice carry alphaI/betaI; the high-affinity electromorph is at high frequency above 2750 m.
replication_targets.test: Directionality check. Establish the polarity from Storz 2009 itself: which isoform combination is the high-altitude, high-affinity form. Report epistaeon's implied direction against that.

structures.notes: Human deoxy (T) state, 1.74 A, four chains complete. About half the alpha1beta2 contacts differ in the R state. Alpha-beta pairs are contacts at exactly one interface (alpha1beta1 or alpha1beta2) and never both, so an interface convention must be fixed and reported. Sites 57 and 64 are haem-pocket residues, 6.5-7.5 A from haem and over 15 A from the nearest beta1 residue.

known_limitations: BLOCKING: no Peromyscus maniculatus sequence exists in the HBA1, HBA2 or HBB TOGA2 alignments, although three assemblies are present in TOGA2. The study's focal species is absent from the input.
Storz 2009 is a deer mouse study only. This registry covers no bird taxa; the alignments are mammal-only in any case.
HBA1 34.5% and HBA2 44.0% of codons are gaps or masked bases. Expect weak signal.
No panel of recombinant genotypes was published. Storz 2009 assayed isoform combinations, not individual substitutions, so there is no order evidence for this system.
Yak and snow leopard are present for HBB only; neither has an HBA1 or HBA2 sequence.
expected_outcome_note: The species needed to test this study's central findings are missing from the input. A verdict of not_testable is the likely honest result. Do not substitute a different rodent and call it a replication.
